scenes.title: The space under the deck was a blind spot
scenes.body: No light, no camera, nothing covering the backyard.

scenes.title: Ring Spotlight Cam on the deck beam
scenes.body: Mounted high, aimed at the yard, wired and set up in the Ring app.

scenes.title: Covering the whole yard
scenes.body: We set the angle and motion zones so it sees the yard, not the street.

scenes.title: Ring Floodlight Cam on the stairs
scenes.body: Bright light and video where people actually walk up.

scenes.title: Backyard covered. Done.
scenes.body: Motion alerts and live view on the homeowner's phone.
